messages:
Mona: Quick check-in 1 Optimize pilot decision: make eval-triggered alerts the pilot P0. Need a low-noise, ship-ready plan for canary this week.

Ryan: Agree. Main concern is noise -> pages. Propose passive-first: send to #optimize-alerts with suggested actions, escalate to oncall only if unresolved 30m. Require min-sample-size and aggregation.

Tess: UI needs compact alert card: eval name, baseline vs current metric, top-3 diffs, suggested mitigation, runbook link, and project opt-out. I can mock the card today.

Sam: From SRE: rate-limit alerts to 1/min per route and aggregate identical alerts within 5m. No paging during pilot. Add FP suppression on manual ack.

Priya: Customer AC (ACME): alert contains failing eval snapshot + top diffs, suggested rollback or config change, one-click opt-out, and audit copy. We'll want example customer text.

Diego: Telemetry: capture alert_count, alert_rate_per_route, time_to_ack, rollback_count, and sample inference traces (10/min per route) for 7d retention. Tag canary data with optimize:pilot.

deploy-bot: CI: optimize/alerts-canary v0.3 deployed to canary. Smoke tests passed. Canary window 1h.

Mona: Action list: Tess -> mock card + runbook snippet (EOD). Ryan -> implement rate-limit & aggregate logic (2d). Sam -> SRE playbook updates (3d). Diego -> dashboard template + retention (2d). Priya -> customer AC + mock text (1d). Ill review GA gating. Will demo after canary. React :thumbsup: if good.
